name: Rites of the Earthmother
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
For you to continue with the Rites of the Earthmother you must pass two more tests. It is time for you to broaden your experience, adventurer.

Travel to Bloodhoof Village and seek out the Chief, Baine Bloodhoof, son of Cairne. There you may continue your journey and earn the acceptance of the elders of Thunder Bluff.

Take this totem to Baine. He will recognize my carvings and help you on your path.

Follow the road out of Camp Narache and travel with haste. Do not stray or you will lose your way.
narrative.objectives: Take the Totem of Hawkwind to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village. Follow the road out of Camp Narache.
narrative.offerRewardText: Word from my good friend, Chief Hawkwind! Ah, I can see by his carvings you are of a special breed.
narrative.requestItemsText: What brings you to my village, Champion?

chain.subtitle: 11 quests from level 2 to 14, 5,055 XP in all.

quests.name: A Humble Task
quests.objectiveText: Chief Hawkwind wants you to search for his mother near the water well to the southeast of Camp Narache.

quests.name: A Humble Task
quests.objectiveText: Take a Water Pitcher from the water well. Return the pitcher to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache which is northwest from the water well.

quests.name: Rites of the Earthmother
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Seer Graytongue who lives in the hills directly south of Camp Narache.

quests.name: Rite of Strength
quests.objectiveText: Kill Bristlebacks in Brambleblade Ravine and bring 12 Bristleback Belts to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.

quests.name: Rites of the Earthmother
quests.objectiveText: Take the Totem of Hawkwind to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: Rite of Vision
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Zarlman Two-Moons in Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: Rite of Vision
quests.objectiveText: Collect 2 Well Stones and 2 Ambercorn and bring them back to Zarlman Two-Moons in Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: Rite of Vision
quests.objectiveText: Consume the Water of the Seers in front of the tribal fire in Bloodhoof Village and follow the vision once it appears.

quests.name: Rite of Wisdom
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Red Rocks east of Thunder Bluff and speak with the Ancestral Spirit.

quests.name: Journey into Thunder Bluff
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Rites of the Earthmother
quests.objectiveText: Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff wants you to bring him the Horn of Arra'chea.
